name: LoC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own champions page lists 3 reigns of the LoC World Heavyweight Championship, from Bryan Danielson (31 March 2007) to Chris Jericho. Its page says the title was vacated or deactivated on 24 June 2007 when the league shut down, and that at the restart of 6 December 2008 Ricky Steamboat gave previous champions their titles back as if the reigns had never ended.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: LoC United States Championship
epitaph: The fed's own champions page lists one reign of the LoC United States Championship: Takeshi Morishima, from 6 December 2008.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: LoC World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own champions page lists 5 reigns of the LoC World Tag Team Championship, from The Hardy Boyz (10 March 2007) to Rated RKO. It was vacated or deactivated when the league shut down on 24 June 2007.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: LoC Pure Wrestling Championship
epitaph: The fed's own champions page lists 2 reigns of the LoC Pure Wrestling Championship, from Colt Cabana (31 March 2007) to Lance Storm. It was vacated or deactivated when the league shut down on 24 June 2007. The page lists it among its inactive championships; its last champion was Lance Storm.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: Sweet N' Sour International Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own champions page lists one reign of the Sweet N' Sour International Tag Team Championship: KENTA/Marufuji, from 31 January 2009. The page lists it under the Sweet N' Sour name rather than LoC's; on the 28 February 2009 card it is billed as the International Tag Team Championship.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: LOC Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Chapter One of 23 April 2010 billed the next week's main event as the match that would crown 'the first LOC Heavyweight Champion'. CM Punk won it over Samoa Joe on Chapter Two, 30 April 2010, with Ricky Steamboat as special guest referee, and kept it over Samoa Joe and AJ Styles on Chapter Three, 7 May 2010, the last held card.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: LOC Elite Championship (2010)
epitaph: Chapter One promised a tournament for 'the first-ever LOC Elite Champion'. Edge won it in a four-way over Austin Starr, Desmond Wolfe and Christopher Daniels at the end of the one-night tournament on Chapter Three, 7 May 2010; the champions page, dated before that night, still lists the title as vacant.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.

name: LOC Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Kings of Wrestling won the first LOC Tag Team Championship on Chapter One, 23 April 2010, in a four-team elimination over the American Wolves, the Briscoe Brothers and the Latin American Exchange; the champions page lists them as champions from that night.
notes: The fed's own belt as its champions page lists it, never a real company's belt.
